title: guzmania zahnii
intro: Guzmania zahnii, commonly known as the Zahn's Guzmania or the Blue Guzmania, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. This epiphytic plant is known for its vibrant blue inflorescence and is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. Guzmania zahnii has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Guzmania zahnii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
